note: Acceptance cases for hammer-brush-csg-subtract-merge-hollow. All boxes are axis-aligned and centred on the origin unless toolOffset moves the tool; volumes are in Geppetto Desktop kernel units (inches, Z-up). The mapcsg test group recomputes every case from this file.

cases.name: subtract-nested
cases.note: 2-cube fully inside a 4-cube: 64 - 8 = 56 (a void inside the solid).

cases.name: subtract-through
cases.note: Cutter spans the full Y width and cuts out the +X side: 64 - 2*4*2 = 48.

cases.name: merge-coplanar
cases.note: Two 2-cubes sharing one face merge into a single 4x2x2 convex brush with 6 faces.

cases.name: hollow-128-t8
cases.note: 128-cube with 8 walls: outer 128^3 = 2097152 minus inner void 112^3 = 1404928 leaves 692224 of wall. 6 outer + 6 inner faces; a hollow shell is not convex.
